provider: HKUST 2025/26 BSc Individualized Interdisciplinary Major curriculum framework
note: The official framework is headed 2026-27 requirements for the 2025-26 intake. It publishes 13 unique coded rows: one of four computing fundamentals, one of six mathematics fundamentals, the 0-credit IIMP 2000 course, and one of the two 6-credit IIMP project alternatives. The remaining Major curriculum is individualized: students design at least 48 required credits and 18 elective credits, subject to committee endorsement and University approval, with level minima that do not identify a closed coded course pool. COMP 1022P remains because the intake-specific PDF lists it while noting that it was last offered in 2024-25 and deleted subsequently. This supplement therefore exposes only the 13 published codes for read-only browsing and must keep totalCreditRequired=0; it cannot be used to calculate a graduation-completion percentage.
